Join us Saturday, November 7th at Ember Music Hall with DJ AB for a 5-hour dance party to celebrate Diwali! Bollywood Night

About this Event

🪩 Nakhra Nights Presents: DISCO DIWALI 🪔✨Saturday, November 7 | 10 PM – 2 AM | Ember Music Hall | Richmond, VA | 21+
This Diwali, turn up the lights and celebrate Nakhra Nights style! ✨
Join us at Ember Music Hall for DISCO DIWALI — a high-energy night where timeless Diwali traditions meet the sounds of the dance floor.
Expect a vibrant mix of Bollywood, Desi Beats, House, Techno & more, with music by DJ AB keeping the party going from 10 PM–2 AM.
Dress to shine, bring your crew, and get ready to dance, celebrate, and light up the night. 🪔💃🏽

✨ What to Expect:
🎶 Bollywood & Desi Beats🪩 House, Techno & More🎧 DJ AB✨ Diwali-inspired atmosphere & décor💃🏽 High-energy dance floor🪔 Lights, music & NakhraSame Tradition. Higher Vibes.
🎟️ Tickets available on now — grab yours and celebrate Diwali under the disco lights!
